title: Applied Econometrics I
description: Regression analysis, including the properties of OLS estimators and test statistics under alternative model assumptions. Additional topics may include functional form, binary variables, F -tests of linear restrictions, heteroskedasticity, instrumental variables estimation and the implications of estimating regression models with time series data.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECON 345, ECON 365 (if taken prior to September 2023), ECON 445 (if taken prior to September 2023).
recommendations: ECON 203 and ECON 204 recommended prior to ECON 345.
